Description.SourceString:
Desert sole is not the music genre of choice for Moon Garou. Instead, the desert sole is a rather flat fish that likes to nestle at the bottom of sandy pools. Being sandy-coloured themselves, it makes for a rather difficult fish to spot, let alone catch.

The flatness of a desert sole once drew the attention of the dragonkin, Lacrussa. She noted the evolutionary benefit of being paper-thin, camouflaged and having organs spread out across the body. So she dabbled with the idea for dragons. Needless to say, her 'flat-dragon' years were some of her least productive.
